goal: Select a fresh grammar deficit without a host-provided task target, change the V3 meta-controller search strategy, generate a new grammar route/operator from that changed meta-strategy, materialize a solver, freeze all candidate identities before sealed evaluation, and preserve prior capabilities.
required_evidence: one fresh pool member remains supported by the inherited V3 grammar
another fresh pool member exposes an unsupported typed signature
the selected deficit is derived from runtime grammar failure
the selected mutation target is derived from meta-generator provenance
the meta search strategy is absent in the parent and present in the candidate
the changed meta-controller generates a new grammar operator absent in the parent grammar
the generated grammar compiles and selects that operator from training score
meta-controller, grammar and solver SHAs freeze before sealed evaluation
fresh sealed UUID leakage is zero
fresh sealed candidate score is 1.0 with positive gain
V1, V2 and V3 sealed retention are 1.0
complete inherited plus Successor regression passes
claim_boundary: The experiment remains bounded because the low-level meta-program vocabulary and all admission gates are host-authored. A PASS demonstrates self-selected deficit handling plus bounded source-level evolution of the meta search strategy; it does not demonstrate unrestricted self-rewrite, general intelligence, consciousness, or G3.
